content:
Alex L: hey team, quick one — my flight just got delayed. i was primary tonight 18:00-02:00 PT; can someone cover primary from 18:00–22:00 PT? i can take back after 22:30 if that's ok. sorry for the last-minute ask. pinging @Priya M because you're listed as my secondary in the rota.
Priya M: @Alex L oof, travel probs. i can take 18:00–21:00 no problem. after 21:00 i have a call, so need to hand off to someone else by then. do we want to do a PagerDuty swap or just shadow for the first bit? also what's the expected customer impact if anything spikes?
Jamie C: I can shadow 18:00–19:30 and handle any quick triage. if Priya needs to drop at 21:00 i can cover 21:00–23:00 as backup. not primary in PD but can get access if we flip.
Ravi S: happy to be on-call primary 21:00–02:00 if needed (i can take PD primary). small ask: do we need to update routing for the eu region? Alex, are you still on your phone?
Alex L: i'm on phone but coverage > connectivity is flaky. prefer we flip PD primary for clarity. no active incidents rn — just FYI: we've got two health check alerts in the last 12h but both auto-resolved. customer-impact is nil atm. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/primary-swap (links in runbook explain PD steps).
Oncall Bot: schedule lookup: tonight 18:00-02:00 PT — Alex L primary; Priya M secondary. Auto-escalation = 10m -> 15m -> 30m. To change primary, create a temporary override or edit the rotation.
Taylor K: +1 to flipping PD primary — less noisy. steps in case folks want them quickly:
```
1) Login to PagerDuty -> Services -> Redwood-Inference-Production
2) Incidents -> Escalation Policies -> click rotation -> Edit -> Add override
3) Set override: from 2026-03-15T18:00PT to 2026-03-15T22:30PT -> Primary = Priya M
4) Save and notify via PD mobile
```
Taylor K: after the override we should also post to #general-ops with a short note so SRE on-call knows.
Priya M: i'll take the override if someone with PD rights can add me (i don't have permission to edit the rotation). @Ravi S can you add?
Ravi S: yep i have PD admin — will add override now. will also update the oncall-playbook checklist: add a note for incident responders to run `rb-run checks` after handoff.
Jamie C: thanks — i'll be watching 18:00–19:30 and will reply to any pings. Priya, i'll DM you a quick handoff snippet at 20:50 so the second swap is cleaner.
Alex L: thank you all, hugely appreciated. i'll mark myself Do Not Disturb for the flight and will add a comment in the PD incident timeline that this was an enforced rotation for tonight. please escalate to me if customer-impact > medium. :pray: :flight_departure:
Priya M: override confirmed by Ravi. PD override id: ov-92012 (Ravi pls confirm). i'll post a 1-line update to #general-ops when i'm primary. :thumbsup:
Ravi S: confirmed — override ov-92012 added: Priya M primary 18:00–22:30 PT, Alex L secondary. updated rotation and left a comment in PD. also added runbook snippet to the override notes:
```
- If CPU spike: run `rb-metrics tail --svc=api` and escalate to infra oncall if > 20% sustained
- If latency > 500ms p50 for 5m -> open incident and notify product
```
Oncall Bot: reminder: checklists -> run `rb-run checks` after handoff. next scheduled oncall sync 2026-03-16 09:00 PT.
Taylor K: all set from infra side. please ping me if we need to flip eu routing or increase autoscale thresholds.
Alex L: leaving my laptop at the gate with a note ;) thanks again team. i'll be reachable after 22:30 PT and will do a clean handback in PD.
Priya M: copy that — see you later. I'll post the handoff confirmation here once i'm fully primary.
Jamie C: good luck on the flight! :airplane:
